en_title: GTA 6 Was Biggest Launch in PlayStation History
cn_title: 《GTA 6》成为PlayStation历史上规模最大的游戏首发
opus_summary: PlayStation表示，《GTA 6》在PS5上吸引超过3900万名独立玩家，创下PlayStation游戏同时在线人数纪录。玩家累计游玩6.83亿小时；游戏发售后，70%的新联网PS5将其作为首款游玩的游戏。Rockstar称该作首日收入达37.9亿美元(约合人民币253亿元)。

paragraphs.en: Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》首发掀起的热潮如今已稍稍平息，PlayStation公布了这款游戏的一些数据，显示它是PlayStation历史上规模最大的一次游戏发行。

paragraphs.en: PlayStation’s November 23 blog post states that more than 39 million unique players have played the game on the PlayStation 5, setting a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any PlayStation game. This beats out other records for multiplayer games, single-player games, and perhaps most astonishingly, even free-to-play titles.
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation于11月23日发布的博客文章称，已有超过3900万名独立玩家在PS5上玩过这款游戏，创下了PlayStation游戏同时在线玩家数量的新纪录。这一成绩超过了多人游戏和单人游戏的其他纪录，或许最令人惊讶的是，它甚至超过了免费游戏的纪录。

paragraphs.en: On top of that, GTA 6 players logged a total of 683 million hours played in the game, with the average player spending an estimated 17.4 hours sticking up virtual pawn shops and stealing NPC’s cars during its first few days.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，《GTA 6》玩家的游戏总时长达到了6.83亿小时；在发售后的头几天里，玩家平均花费了估计17.4小时抢劫虚拟当铺和偷窃NPC的汽车。

paragraphs.en: What’s more impressive is the sheer amount of people who purchased PS5s specifically to play GTA 6. PlayStation’s blog says it saw the “largest number of newly-connected PS5 consoles on a single day” since the console’s launch in November 2020, not counting end-of-year holidays like Christmas. Since GTA 6’s launch, it was the first game played on 70% of these new consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 更令人印象深刻的是专门为玩《GTA 6》而购买PS5的人数。PlayStation博客称，除圣诞节等年末假期外，它迎来了自2020年11月主机推出以来「单日新连接PS5主机数量最多」的一天。自《GTA 6》推出以来，它是这些新主机中70%首次运行的游戏。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 has, perhaps unsurprisingly, broken a slew of big records. The most prominent of these is its status as the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with Rockstar reporting that the game earned $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》打破了一连串重大纪录，或许这并不令人意外。其中最突出的是，它成为了有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品首发；Rockstar称，这款游戏在最初24小时内赚取了37.9亿美元。

paragraphs.en: On top of this, internet provider Comcast said that GTA 6’s launch day was its highest-traffic day ever , with 24% of all its internet traffic during peak times coming from users downloading and playing Rockstar’s latest offering. Xbox had its own big records, too; Xfinity, which is under the Comcast umbrella, said GTA 6 increased the internet traffic on Xbox consoles by four times the normal amount this November.
paragraphs.cn: 除此之外，互联网服务提供商Comcast表示，《GTA 6》发售当天是其有史以来流量最高的一天，高峰时段全部网络流量的24%来自下载和游玩Rockstar这款最新作品的用户。XBOX也创下了自己的重大纪录；Comcast旗下的Xfinity表示，今年11月，《GTA 6》使XBOX主机的网络流量增加了正常水平的四倍。

paragraphs.en: People are still making new discoveries in this game, and there’s bound to be many more that pop up over the next few months. GTA 6 is up for eight awards at The Game Awards and has enjoyed massive critical reception, with IGN scoring it a glowing 10 out of 10 — the title of ‘Masterpiece.’ Reviewer Luke Reilly praised the game for being “exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered,” saying “Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played.”
paragraphs.cn: 人们仍在这款游戏中不断有新发现，接下来的几个月里肯定还会涌现更多发现。《GTA 6》获得了The Game Awards的八项提名，并赢得了评论界的极高评价，IGN给出了满分10分，并冠以「杰作」的称号。评测者Luke Reilly称赞这款游戏「细节精美绝伦，始终充满可供尝试的可能性，制作上毫不妥协」，并表示：「《GTA 6》是我玩过的最令人印象深刻的一款电子游戏。」

paragraphs.en: It’s unlikely that we see a game release as big as this one, with such a massive cultural impact, ever again. Rockstar certainly set a new standard for the industry with this one, to the point where many users aren’t sure if a photo they see online is from the real world or from the game .
paragraphs.cn: 我们恐怕再也难以看到规模如此之大、文化影响力如此深远的游戏发行了。Rockstar凭借这款游戏确实为业界树立了新标准，以至于许多用户无法确定自己在网上看到的一张照片是来自现实世界还是游戏。
